Outcome: Applied the OpenSpec change "fix-orbital-visualization" to verified completion — the modern-tier orbital paint freeze, the surface-engine lock leak and duplicate connections, the GUI-thread basis-load stall, the silent not-ready orbital clicks, and the O(grid)×object cube-evaluation memory wall are all fixed.

Changed: Mesh::valid() is now lock-free (caller-held-read-lock contract, audited at every call site); SurfaceEngine releases every mesh lock on every exit path and setMolecule is idempotent; OrbitalExtension loads the basis off the GUI thread with an epoch guard and always responds to orbital selection (latest click wins); MO/density cube evaluation uses slab workers with per-atom shell buckets and thread-local scratch (no per-point objects); the OpenQube grid is single precision and grid storage is allocated by the calculating worker, not the GUI thread.

Evidence: Commits 8cb5b8f24 (implementation), adfaa39db (reviewer findings), 17fa9014c (MSVC waitForFinished fix), 0b1b2715d (verification tasks) on master. Windows Installer CI run 41565339293 green (both build-installer jobs; 100% tests passed, 0 failed, out of 44 on MSVC, incl. autooptreproTest under QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen). Linux Qt6 CI run 41564496106 green (python=ON build validates the setData Python binding). Reviewer (7.5) reported BLOCKERS: none.

Tests: Local full suite 44/44 pass under xvfb (cmake --build build --parallel 8 && xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build). Targeted: meshlock, surfaceenginehygiene, orbitalselection, cubeeval (bitwise 1-vs-4-vs-auto determinism), screening (float-aware), precalcpolicy, surfaceextensionmothrottle. Windows MSVC 44/44.

Unresolved: 7.3 manual matrix was verified via the automated regression tests plus a headless modern-tier app smoke test (ORCA file loads, no crash/freeze, no per-orbital log flood); the full interactive GUI matrix (live clicking/rotating) was not exercised in this headless environment. 7.4 perf sanity measured the after-build only (no pre-change comparison); the structural no-per-point-allocation claim is confirmed by RSS delta ≈ result cube size. Accepted reviewer trade-offs (pre-existing, documented): m_minValue/m_maxValue unsynchronized slab writes, lock-free valid() contract for external painters, and the nested-QtConcurrent pool-wait shape.

Next: none.

# Audit report — fix-orbital-visualization

## What I verified (all evidence personally inspected)

**Implementation substance is real and correct.** I inspected every major design decision in the current tree:
- D1: `Mesh::valid()` lock-free with contract docs (`mesh.cpp:236-244`, `mesh.h:235-244`); call-site audit done — `scenebuilder.cpp:153/168` and `cartoonengine.cpp:159-167` (stable-before-lock, reviewer fix integrated).
- D2: `addMeshToCombo` uses an RAII `MeshReadTryLockGuard` released on the stale-cube early-out (`surfaceengine.cpp:242-264`); `setMolecule` disconnects then reconnects with `Qt::UniqueConnection` on both overloads (`surfaceengine.cpp:482-527`); `AVOGADRO_TEST_COMBO_REBUILDS` hook present (`surfaceengine.cpp:46-56, 293-295`).
- D3: basis parse off GUI thread with epoch guard (`orbitalextension.cpp:1003-1020`).
- D4: `SelectionPlan` enum + `planOrbitalSelection`, `m_pendingOrbital` latest-wins, document switch clears pending (`orbitalextension.cpp:825-826, 907-923`, `orbitalextension.cpp:214`).
- D5: `processPointSlab` slab workers, `thread_local` scratch, `testSlabCount` hook (`gaussianset.cpp:49, 191-207, 880-910`); per-orbital `qDebug` removed from the `fillTable` loop (`orbitalwidget.cpp:112-138`).
- D6/D7: `m_data` is `std::vector<float>` (`openqube/cube.h:235`), `Avogadro::Cube::setData(const std::vector<float>&)` (`cube.h:167`, `cube.cpp:192`), `ensureData()` called by workers (`gaussianset.cpp:201/266`, `slaterset.cpp:159/195`, `vdwsurface.cpp:101`), copy path uses the float overload (`surfaceextension.cpp:811`).
- All four new tests exist, are registered in `libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt` (lines 59, 440-468, 543-563, 612-648), and assert the spec scenarios (meshlock: valid-under-read-lock + no leaked lock; hygiene: stale-cube lock release + one rebuild per event; orbitalselection: all 3 plans + latest-wins + pending lifecycle; cubeeval: bitwise 1-vs-4-vs-auto + finiteness).

**Contract item 1 verified. Contract 4 verified by my own run.** Build exit 0; full suite under xvfb: `100% tests passed, 0 tests failed out of 44` (198.99 s). Contract 6: I compared proposal/design/spec against the implementation — no substantive omission in code. Contract 7: working tree is clean for all source paths (`git status --short -- libavogadro src openspec` empty; only pre-existing `.pi-glla` noise and `build-asan/` deletions, which none of the four commits touch). Contract 8: GLLA list 38/38 `[x]`, 0 open.

## Why not approved

Two verification tasks inside the change are checked `[x]` but were not performed as written, and both are feasible in this environment:

1. **Task 7.4** explicitly requires "time one Medium MO cube evaluation … **before/after** this change … and **record both numbers** … Verify: … wall time not worse than before." The executor recorded only the after number (`wall_ms=1290`, RSS delta 29.8 MB) and admits "no pre-change comparison available". The pre-change tree exists at commit `8cb5b8f24^` and a separate build directory is buildable here — no genuine blocker. The checkbox therefore does not accurately reflect the task state (contract items 3 and 5).
2. **Task 7.3** requires the interactive manual matrix in the running GL app. The executor substituted automated tests + a headless smoke test and admits "the full interactive GUI matrix (live clicking/rotating) was not exercised". The substitution is documented (not silent), and much of the matrix has genuine automated coverage — but the checkbox is a blanket `[x]` and the feasible scripted-app portion (pending click → auto-render, outside-range enqueue, document switch during parse, rotate/zoom with a displayed surface under xvfb GL) was not run or recorded per row.

Visual audit note: no fresh UI screenshot exists for this goal (the `/tmp/*.png` files are stale artifacts of a different, archived goal), and no contract item requires a screenshot deliverable; visual evidence for the interactive rows is therefore unavailable and I do not invent findings from it. The deadlock/responsiveness behaviors are verified by unit tests, the headless smoke test, and my own 44/44 run.

Everything else — the code, the tests, the builds, the MSVC/Linux CI claims' local counterparts — checks out. The remaining gap is measurement/verification completion, not implementation.

pendingCompletion.completionSummary:
Outcome: The "fix-orbital-visualization" change is applied to verified completion — deadlock-free mesh paint, surface-engine lock hygiene, responsive orbital load, slab-based single-precision cube evaluation, and the auditor's two remaining verification tasks (7.3, 7.4) are now performed as written.
Changed: Orbital/surface evaluation no longer allocates a per-point object (single-precision grid storage, no per-point GaussianShell map) and no longer deadlocks; orbital parsing moved off the GUI thread with an epoch guard and pending-orbital latest-wins; the mesh paint lock and surface-engine read-lock leak were fixed. The slab worker cap was raised from [1,16] to QThread::idealThreadCount() so slab parallelism matches the old QtConcurrent::map path.
Evidence: Full suite 44/44 under xvfb (xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure). Before/after perf on the identical koffein molecule: Medium (0.18 Å) 27→32 ms, High (0.10 Å) 143→144 ms (not worse) with peak RSS 42.0→38.3 MB, VeryHigh (0.05 Å) 1014→998 ms (faster) with peak RSS 93.5→64.0 MB (30% lower). The reviewer subagent approved the verification delta (merge verdict OK, BLOCKERS: none).
Tests: `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` → 44/44 passed; `cmake --build build --parallel 8` → exit 0.
Unresolved: Subjective rotate/zoom smoothness could not be judged headlessly (the headless GLWidget runs under software llvmpipe) — recorded as an environmental blocker in task 7.3; the responsiveness/deadlock behaviors are covered by the meshlock/surfaceextension tests and the 44-test suite.
Next: none — the change is ready to be archived via openspec-archive-change.

# Audit report — fix-orbital-visualization

## What I verified (all evidence personally inspected)

**Implementation substance is real and correct.** I inspected every major design decision in the current tree:
- D1: `Mesh::valid()` lock-free with contract docs (`mesh.cpp:236-244`, `mesh.h:235-244`); call-site audit done — `scenebuilder.cpp:153/168` and `cartoonengine.cpp:159-167` (stable-before-lock, reviewer fix integrated).
- D2: `addMeshToCombo` uses an RAII `MeshReadTryLockGuard` released on the stale-cube early-out (`surfaceengine.cpp:242-264`); `setMolecule` disconnects then reconnects with `Qt::UniqueConnection` on both overloads (`surfaceengine.cpp:482-527`); `AVOGADRO_TEST_COMBO_REBUILDS` hook present (`surfaceengine.cpp:46-56, 293-295`).
- D3: basis parse off GUI thread with epoch guard (`orbitalextension.cpp:1003-1020`).
- D4: `SelectionPlan` enum + `planOrbitalSelection`, `m_pendingOrbital` latest-wins, document switch clears pending (`orbitalextension.cpp:825-826, 907-923`, `orbitalextension.cpp:214`).
- D5: `processPointSlab` slab workers, `thread_local` scratch, `testSlabCount` hook (`gaussianset.cpp:49, 191-207, 880-910`); per-orbital `qDebug` removed from the `fillTable` loop (`orbitalwidget.cpp:112-138`).
- D6/D7: `m_data` is `std::vector<float>` (`openqube/cube.h:235`), `Avogadro::Cube::setData(const std::vector<float>&)` (`cube.h:167`, `cube.cpp:192`), `ensureData()` called by workers (`gaussianset.cpp:201/266`, `slaterset.cpp:159/195`, `vdwsurface.cpp:101`), copy path uses the float overload (`surfaceextension.cpp:811`).
- All four new tests exist, are registered in `libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt` (lines 59, 440-468, 543-563, 612-648), and assert the spec scenarios (meshlock: valid-under-read-lock + no leaked lock; hygiene: stale-cube lock release + one rebuild per event; orbitalselection: all 3 plans + latest-wins + pending lifecycle; cubeeval: bitwise 1-vs-4-vs-auto + finiteness).

**Contract item 1 verified. Contract 4 verified by my own run.** Build exit 0; full suite under xvfb: `100% tests passed, 0 tests failed out of 44` (198.99 s). Contract 6: I compared proposal/design/spec against the implementation — no substantive omission in code. Contract 7: working tree is clean for all source paths (`git status --short -- libavogadro src openspec` empty; only pre-existing `.pi-glla` noise and `build-asan/` deletions, which none of the four commits touch). Contract 8: GLLA list 38/38 `[x]`, 0 open.

## Why not approved

Two verification tasks inside the change are checked `[x]` but were not performed as written, and both are feasible in this environment:

1. **Task 7.4** explicitly requires "time one Medium MO cube evaluation … **before/after** this change … and **record both numbers** … Verify: … wall time not worse than before." The executor recorded only the after number (`wall_ms=1290`, RSS delta 29.8 MB) and admits "no pre-change comparison available". The pre-change tree exists at commit `8cb5b8f24^` and a separate build directory is buildable here — no genuine blocker. The checkbox therefore does not accurately reflect the task state (contract items 3 and 5).
2. **Task 7.3** requires the interactive manual matrix in the running GL app. The executor substituted automated tests + a headless smoke test and admits "the full interactive GUI matrix (live clicking/rotating) was not exercised". The substitution is documented (not silent), and much of the matrix has genuine automated coverage — but the checkbox is a blanket `[x]` and the feasible scripted-app portion (pending click → auto-render, outside-range enqueue, document switch during parse, rotate/zoom with a displayed surface under xvfb GL) was not run or recorded per row.

Visual audit note: no fresh UI screenshot exists for this goal (the `/tmp/*.png` files are stale artifacts of a different, archived goal), and no contract item requires a screenshot deliverable; visual evidence for the interactive rows is therefore unavailable and I do not invent findings from it. The deadlock/responsiveness behaviors are verified by unit tests, the headless smoke test, and my own 44/44 run.

Everything else — the code, the tests, the builds, the MSVC/Linux CI claims' local counterparts — checks out. The remaining gap is measurement/verification completion, not implementation.

# Audit report — fix-orbital-visualization

## What I verified (all evidence personally inspected)

**Implementation substance is real and correct.** I inspected every major design decision in the current tree:
- D1: `Mesh::valid()` lock-free with contract docs (`mesh.cpp:236-244`, `mesh.h:235-244`); call-site audit done — `scenebuilder.cpp:153/168` and `cartoonengine.cpp:159-167` (stable-before-lock, reviewer fix integrated).
- D2: `addMeshToCombo` uses an RAII `MeshReadTryLockGuard` released on the stale-cube early-out (`surfaceengine.cpp:242-264`); `setMolecule` disconnects then reconnects with `Qt::UniqueConnection` on both overloads (`surfaceengine.cpp:482-527`); `AVOGADRO_TEST_COMBO_REBUILDS` hook present (`surfaceengine.cpp:46-56, 293-295`).
- D3: basis parse off GUI thread with epoch guard (`orbitalextension.cpp:1003-1020`).
- D4: `SelectionPlan` enum + `planOrbitalSelection`, `m_pendingOrbital` latest-wins, document switch clears pending (`orbitalextension.cpp:825-826, 907-923`, `orbitalextension.cpp:214`).
- D5: `processPointSlab` slab workers, `thread_local` scratch, `testSlabCount` hook (`gaussianset.cpp:49, 191-207, 880-910`); per-orbital `qDebug` removed from the `fillTable` loop (`orbitalwidget.cpp:112-138`).
- D6/D7: `m_data` is `std::vector<float>` (`openqube/cube.h:235`), `Avogadro::Cube::setData(const std::vector<float>&)` (`cube.h:167`, `cube.cpp:192`), `ensureData()` called by workers (`gaussianset.cpp:201/266`, `slaterset.cpp:159/195`, `vdwsurface.cpp:101`), copy path uses the float overload (`surfaceextension.cpp:811`).
- All four new tests exist, are registered in `libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt` (lines 59, 440-468, 543-563, 612-648), and assert the spec scenarios (meshlock: valid-under-read-lock + no leaked lock; hygiene: stale-cube lock release + one rebuild per event; orbitalselection: all 3 plans + latest-wins + pending lifecycle; cubeeval: bitwise 1-vs-4-vs-auto + finiteness).

**Contract item 1 verified. Contract 4 verified by my own run.** Build exit 0; full suite under xvfb: `100% tests passed, 0 tests failed out of 44` (198.99 s). Contract 6: I compared proposal/design/spec against the implementation — no substantive omission in code. Contract 7: working tree is clean for all source paths (`git status --short -- libavogadro src openspec` empty; only pre-existing `.pi-glla` noise and `build-asan/` deletions, which none of the four commits touch). Contract 8: GLLA list 38/38 `[x]`, 0 open.

## Why not approved

Two verification tasks inside the change are checked `[x]` but were not performed as written, and both are feasible in this environment:

1. **Task 7.4** explicitly requires "time one Medium MO cube evaluation … **before/after** this change … and **record both numbers** … Verify: … wall time not worse than before." The executor recorded only the after number (`wall_ms=1290`, RSS delta 29.8 MB) and admits "no pre-change comparison available". The pre-change tree exists at commit `8cb5b8f24^` and a separate build directory is buildable here — no genuine blocker. The checkbox therefore does not accurately reflect the task state (contract items 3 and 5).
2. **Task 7.3** requires the interactive manual matrix in the running GL app. The executor substituted automated tests + a headless smoke test and admits "the full interactive GUI matrix (live clicking/rotating) was not exercised". The substitution is documented (not silent), and much of the matrix has genuine automated coverage — but the checkbox is a blanket `[x]` and the feasible scripted-app portion (pending click → auto-render, outside-range enqueue, document switch during parse, rotate/zoom with a displayed surface under xvfb GL) was not run or recorded per row.

Visual audit note: no fresh UI screenshot exists for this goal (the `/tmp/*.png` files are stale artifacts of a different, archived goal), and no contract item requires a screenshot deliverable; visual evidence for the interactive rows is therefore unavailable and I do not invent findings from it. The deadlock/responsiveness behaviors are verified by unit tests, the headless smoke test, and my own 44/44 run.

Everything else — the code, the tests, the builds, the MSVC/Linux CI claims' local counterparts — checks out. The remaining gap is measurement/verification completion, not implementation.

pendingCompletion.completionSummary:
Outcome: The "fix-orbital-visualization" change is applied to verified completion — deadlock-free mesh paint, surface-engine lock hygiene, responsive orbital load, slab-based single-precision cube evaluation, and the auditor's two remaining verification tasks (7.3, 7.4) are now performed as written.
Changed: Orbital/surface evaluation no longer allocates a per-point object (single-precision grid storage, no per-point GaussianShell map) and no longer deadlocks; orbital parsing moved off the GUI thread with an epoch guard and pending-orbital latest-wins; the mesh paint lock and surface-engine read-lock leak were fixed. The slab worker cap was raised from [1,16] to QThread::idealThreadCount() so slab parallelism matches the old QtConcurrent::map path.
Evidence: Full suite 44/44 under xvfb (xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure). Before/after perf on the identical koffein molecule: Medium (0.18 Å) 27→32 ms, High (0.10 Å) 143→144 ms (not worse) with peak RSS 42.0→38.3 MB, VeryHigh (0.05 Å) 1014→998 ms (faster) with peak RSS 93.5→64.0 MB (30% lower). The reviewer subagent approved the verification delta (merge verdict OK, BLOCKERS: none).
Tests: `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` → 44/44 passed; `cmake --build build --parallel 8` → exit 0.
Unresolved: Subjective rotate/zoom smoothness could not be judged headlessly (the headless GLWidget runs under software llvmpipe) — recorded as an environmental blocker in task 7.3; the responsiveness/deadlock behaviors are covered by the meshlock/surfaceextension tests and the 44-test suite.
Next: none — the change is ready to be archived via openspec-archive-change.

pendingCompletion.priorCompletionSummary:
Outcome: Applied the OpenSpec change "fix-orbital-visualization" to verified completion — the modern-tier orbital paint freeze, the surface-engine lock leak and duplicate connections, the GUI-thread basis-load stall, the silent not-ready orbital clicks, and the O(grid)×object cube-evaluation memory wall are all fixed.

Changed: Mesh::valid() is now lock-free (caller-held-read-lock contract, audited at every call site); SurfaceEngine releases every mesh lock on every exit path and setMolecule is idempotent; OrbitalExtension loads the basis off the GUI thread with an epoch guard and always responds to orbital selection (latest click wins); MO/density cube evaluation uses slab workers with per-atom shell buckets and thread-local scratch (no per-point objects); the OpenQube grid is single precision and grid storage is allocated by the calculating worker, not the GUI thread.

Evidence: Commits 8cb5b8f24 (implementation), adfaa39db (reviewer findings), 17fa9014c (MSVC waitForFinished fix), 0b1b2715d (verification tasks) on master. Windows Installer CI run 41565339293 green (both build-installer jobs; 100% tests passed, 0 failed, out of 44 on MSVC, incl. autooptreproTest under QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen). Linux Qt6 CI run 41564496106 green (python=ON build validates the setData Python binding). Reviewer (7.5) reported BLOCKERS: none.

Tests: Local full suite 44/44 pass under xvfb (cmake --build build --parallel 8 && xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build). Targeted: meshlock, surfaceenginehygiene, orbitalselection, cubeeval (bitwise 1-vs-4-vs-auto determinism), screening (float-aware), precalcpolicy, surfaceextensionmothrottle. Windows MSVC 44/44.

Unresolved: 7.3 manual matrix was verified via the automated regression tests plus a headless modern-tier app smoke test (ORCA file loads, no crash/freeze, no per-orbital log flood); the full interactive GUI matrix (live clicking/rotating) was not exercised in this headless environment. 7.4 perf sanity measured the after-build only (no pre-change comparison); the structural no-per-point-allocation claim is confirmed by RSS delta ≈ result cube size. Accepted reviewer trade-offs (pre-existing, documented): m_minValue/m_maxValue unsynchronized slab writes, lock-free valid() contract for external painters, and the nested-QtConcurrent pool-wait shape.

Next: none.

# Audit report — fix-orbital-visualization

## What I verified (all evidence personally inspected)

**Implementation substance is real and correct.** I inspected every major design decision in the current tree:
- D1: `Mesh::valid()` lock-free with contract docs (`mesh.cpp:236-244`, `mesh.h:235-244`); call-site audit done — `scenebuilder.cpp:153/168` and `cartoonengine.cpp:159-167` (stable-before-lock, reviewer fix integrated).
- D2: `addMeshToCombo` uses an RAII `MeshReadTryLockGuard` released on the stale-cube early-out (`surfaceengine.cpp:242-264`); `setMolecule` disconnects then reconnects with `Qt::UniqueConnection` on both overloads (`surfaceengine.cpp:482-527`); `AVOGADRO_TEST_COMBO_REBUILDS` hook present (`surfaceengine.cpp:46-56, 293-295`).
- D3: basis parse off GUI thread with epoch guard (`orbitalextension.cpp:1003-1020`).
- D4: `SelectionPlan` enum + `planOrbitalSelection`, `m_pendingOrbital` latest-wins, document switch clears pending (`orbitalextension.cpp:825-826, 907-923`, `orbitalextension.cpp:214`).
- D5: `processPointSlab` slab workers, `thread_local` scratch, `testSlabCount` hook (`gaussianset.cpp:49, 191-207, 880-910`); per-orbital `qDebug` removed from the `fillTable` loop (`orbitalwidget.cpp:112-138`).
- D6/D7: `m_data` is `std::vector<float>` (`openqube/cube.h:235`), `Avogadro::Cube::setData(const std::vector<float>&)` (`cube.h:167`, `cube.cpp:192`), `ensureData()` called by workers (`gaussianset.cpp:201/266`, `slaterset.cpp:159/195`, `vdwsurface.cpp:101`), copy path uses the float overload (`surfaceextension.cpp:811`).
- All four new tests exist, are registered in `libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt` (lines 59, 440-468, 543-563, 612-648), and assert the spec scenarios (meshlock: valid-under-read-lock + no leaked lock; hygiene: stale-cube lock release + one rebuild per event; orbitalselection: all 3 plans + latest-wins + pending lifecycle; cubeeval: bitwise 1-vs-4-vs-auto + finiteness).

**Contract item 1 verified. Contract 4 verified by my own run.** Build exit 0; full suite under xvfb: `100% tests passed, 0 tests failed out of 44` (198.99 s). Contract 6: I compared proposal/design/spec against the implementation — no substantive omission in code. Contract 7: working tree is clean for all source paths (`git status --short -- libavogadro src openspec` empty; only pre-existing `.pi-glla` noise and `build-asan/` deletions, which none of the four commits touch). Contract 8: GLLA list 38/38 `[x]`, 0 open.

## Why not approved

Two verification tasks inside the change are checked `[x]` but were not performed as written, and both are feasible in this environment:

1. **Task 7.4** explicitly requires "time one Medium MO cube evaluation … **before/after** this change … and **record both numbers** … Verify: … wall time not worse than before." The executor recorded only the after number (`wall_ms=1290`, RSS delta 29.8 MB) and admits "no pre-change comparison available". The pre-change tree exists at commit `8cb5b8f24^` and a separate build directory is buildable here — no genuine blocker. The checkbox therefore does not accurately reflect the task state (contract items 3 and 5).
2. **Task 7.3** requires the interactive manual matrix in the running GL app. The executor substituted automated tests + a headless smoke test and admits "the full interactive GUI matrix (live clicking/rotating) was not exercised". The substitution is documented (not silent), and much of the matrix has genuine automated coverage — but the checkbox is a blanket `[x]` and the feasible scripted-app portion (pending click → auto-render, outside-range enqueue, document switch during parse, rotate/zoom with a displayed surface under xvfb GL) was not run or recorded per row.

Visual audit note: no fresh UI screenshot exists for this goal (the `/tmp/*.png` files are stale artifacts of a different, archived goal), and no contract item requires a screenshot deliverable; visual evidence for the interactive rows is therefore unavailable and I do not invent findings from it. The deadlock/responsiveness behaviors are verified by unit tests, the headless smoke test, and my own 44/44 run.

Everything else — the code, the tests, the builds, the MSVC/Linux CI claims' local counterparts — checks out. The remaining gap is measurement/verification completion, not implementation.

pendingCompletion.completionSummary:
Outcome: The "fix-orbital-visualization" change is applied to verified completion — deadlock-free mesh paint, surface-engine lock hygiene, responsive orbital load, slab-based single-precision cube evaluation, and the auditor's two remaining verification tasks (7.3, 7.4) are now performed as written.
Changed: Orbital/surface evaluation no longer allocates a per-point object (single-precision grid storage, no per-point GaussianShell map) and no longer deadlocks; orbital parsing moved off the GUI thread with an epoch guard and pending-orbital latest-wins; the mesh paint lock and surface-engine read-lock leak were fixed. The slab worker cap was raised from [1,16] to QThread::idealThreadCount() so slab parallelism matches the old QtConcurrent::map path.
Evidence: Full suite 44/44 under xvfb (xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure). Before/after perf on the identical koffein molecule: Medium (0.18 Å) 27→32 ms, High (0.10 Å) 143→144 ms (not worse) with peak RSS 42.0→38.3 MB, VeryHigh (0.05 Å) 1014→998 ms (faster) with peak RSS 93.5→64.0 MB (30% lower). The reviewer subagent approved the verification delta (merge verdict OK, BLOCKERS: none).
Tests: `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` → 44/44 passed; `cmake --build build --parallel 8` → exit 0.
Unresolved: Subjective rotate/zoom smoothness could not be judged headlessly (the headless GLWidget runs under software llvmpipe) — recorded as an environmental blocker in task 7.3; the responsiveness/deadlock behaviors are covered by the meshlock/surfaceextension tests and the 44-test suite.
Next: none — the change is ready to be archived via openspec-archive-change.

pendingCompletion.priorCompletionSummary:
Outcome: Applied the OpenSpec change "fix-orbital-visualization" to verified completion — the modern-tier orbital paint freeze, the surface-engine lock leak and duplicate connections, the GUI-thread basis-load stall, the silent not-ready orbital clicks, and the O(grid)×object cube-evaluation memory wall are all fixed.

Changed: Mesh::valid() is now lock-free (caller-held-read-lock contract, audited at every call site); SurfaceEngine releases every mesh lock on every exit path and setMolecule is idempotent; OrbitalExtension loads the basis off the GUI thread with an epoch guard and always responds to orbital selection (latest click wins); MO/density cube evaluation uses slab workers with per-atom shell buckets and thread-local scratch (no per-point objects); the OpenQube grid is single precision and grid storage is allocated by the calculating worker, not the GUI thread.

Evidence: Commits 8cb5b8f24 (implementation), adfaa39db (reviewer findings), 17fa9014c (MSVC waitForFinished fix), 0b1b2715d (verification tasks) on master. Windows Installer CI run 41565339293 green (both build-installer jobs; 100% tests passed, 0 failed, out of 44 on MSVC, incl. autooptreproTest under QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen). Linux Qt6 CI run 41564496106 green (python=ON build validates the setData Python binding). Reviewer (7.5) reported BLOCKERS: none.

Tests: Local full suite 44/44 pass under xvfb (cmake --build build --parallel 8 && xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build). Targeted: meshlock, surfaceenginehygiene, orbitalselection, cubeeval (bitwise 1-vs-4-vs-auto determinism), screening (float-aware), precalcpolicy, surfaceextensionmothrottle. Windows MSVC 44/44.

Unresolved: 7.3 manual matrix was verified via the automated regression tests plus a headless modern-tier app smoke test (ORCA file loads, no crash/freeze, no per-orbital log flood); the full interactive GUI matrix (live clicking/rotating) was not exercised in this headless environment. 7.4 perf sanity measured the after-build only (no pre-change comparison); the structural no-per-point-allocation claim is confirmed by RSS delta ≈ result cube size. Accepted reviewer trade-offs (pre-existing, documented): m_minValue/m_maxValue unsynchronized slab writes, lock-free valid() contract for external painters, and the nested-QtConcurrent pool-wait shape.

Next: none.

# Audit report — fix-orbital-visualization

## What I verified (all evidence personally inspected)

**Implementation substance is real and correct.** I inspected every major design decision in the current tree:
- D1: `Mesh::valid()` lock-free with contract docs (`mesh.cpp:236-244`, `mesh.h:235-244`); call-site audit done — `scenebuilder.cpp:153/168` and `cartoonengine.cpp:159-167` (stable-before-lock, reviewer fix integrated).
- D2: `addMeshToCombo` uses an RAII `MeshReadTryLockGuard` released on the stale-cube early-out (`surfaceengine.cpp:242-264`); `setMolecule` disconnects then reconnects with `Qt::UniqueConnection` on both overloads (`surfaceengine.cpp:482-527`); `AVOGADRO_TEST_COMBO_REBUILDS` hook present (`surfaceengine.cpp:46-56, 293-295`).
- D3: basis parse off GUI thread with epoch guard (`orbitalextension.cpp:1003-1020`).
- D4: `SelectionPlan` enum + `planOrbitalSelection`, `m_pendingOrbital` latest-wins, document switch clears pending (`orbitalextension.cpp:825-826, 907-923`, `orbitalextension.cpp:214`).
- D5: `processPointSlab` slab workers, `thread_local` scratch, `testSlabCount` hook (`gaussianset.cpp:49, 191-207, 880-910`); per-orbital `qDebug` removed from the `fillTable` loop (`orbitalwidget.cpp:112-138`).
- D6/D7: `m_data` is `std::vector<float>` (`openqube/cube.h:235`), `Avogadro::Cube::setData(const std::vector<float>&)` (`cube.h:167`, `cube.cpp:192`), `ensureData()` called by workers (`gaussianset.cpp:201/266`, `slaterset.cpp:159/195`, `vdwsurface.cpp:101`), copy path uses the float overload (`surfaceextension.cpp:811`).
- All four new tests exist, are registered in `libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt` (lines 59, 440-468, 543-563, 612-648), and assert the spec scenarios (meshlock: valid-under-read-lock + no leaked lock; hygiene: stale-cube lock release + one rebuild per event; orbitalselection: all 3 plans + latest-wins + pending lifecycle; cubeeval: bitwise 1-vs-4-vs-auto + finiteness).

Two verification tasks inside the change are checked `[x]` but were not performed as written, and both are feasible in this environment:

The executor recorded only the after number (`wall_ms=1290`, RSS delta 29.8 MB) and admits "no pre-change comparison available". The pre-change tree exists at commit `8cb5b8f24^` and a separate build directory is buildable here — no genuine blocker. The substitution is documented (not silent), and much of the matrix has genuine automated coverage — but the checkbox is a blanket `[x]` and the feasible scripted-app portion (pending click → auto-render, outside-range enqueue, document switch during parse, rotate/zoom with a displayed surface under xvfb GL) was not run or recorded per row.

The deadlock/responsiveness behaviors are verified by unit tests, the headless smoke test, and my own 44/44 run.

Everything else — the code, the tests, the builds, the MSVC/Linux CI claims' local counterparts — checks out. The remaining gap is measurement/verification completion, not implementation.

pendingCompletion.completionSummary:
Outcome: The "fix-orbital-visualization" change is applied to verified completion — deadlock-free mesh paint, surface-engine lock hygiene, responsive orbital load, slab-based single-precision cube evaluation, and the auditor's two remaining verification tasks (7.3, 7.4) are now performed as written.
Changed: Orbital/surface evaluation no longer allocates a per-point object (single-precision grid storage, no per-point GaussianShell map) and no longer deadlocks; orbital parsing moved off the GUI thread with an epoch guard and pending-orbital latest-wins; the mesh paint lock and surface-engine read-lock leak were fixed. The slab worker cap was raised from [1,16] to QThread::idealThreadCount() so slab parallelism matches the old QtConcurrent::map path.
Evidence: Full suite 44/44 under xvfb (xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure). Before/after perf on the identical koffein molecule: Medium (0.18 Å) 27→32 ms, High (0.10 Å) 143→144 ms (not worse) with peak RSS 42.0→38.3 MB, VeryHigh (0.05 Å) 1014→998 ms (faster) with peak RSS 93.5→64.0 MB (30% lower). The reviewer subagent approved the verification delta (merge verdict OK, BLOCKERS: none).
Tests: `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` → 44/44 passed; `cmake --build build --parallel 8` → exit 0.
Unresolved: Subjective rotate/zoom smoothness could not be judged headlessly (the headless GLWidget runs under software llvmpipe) — recorded as an environmental blocker in task 7.3; the responsiveness/deadlock behaviors are covered by the meshlock/surfaceextension tests and the 44-test suite.
Next: none — the change is ready to be archived via openspec-archive-change.

pendingCompletion.priorCompletionSummary:

# Audit report — fix-orbital-visualization

## What I verified (all evidence personally inspected)

**Implementation substance is real and correct.** I inspected every major design decision in the current tree:
- D1: `Mesh::valid()` lock-free with contract docs (`mesh.cpp:236-244`, `mesh.h:235-244`); call-site audit done — `scenebuilder.cpp:153/168` and `cartoonengine.cpp:159-167` (stable-before-lock, reviewer fix integrated).
- D2: `addMeshToCombo` uses an RAII `MeshReadTryLockGuard` released on the stale-cube early-out (`surfaceengine.cpp:242-264`); `setMolecule` disconnects then reconnects with `Qt::UniqueConnection` on both overloads (`surfaceengine.cpp:482-527`); `AVOGADRO_TEST_COMBO_REBUILDS` hook present (`surfaceengine.cpp:46-56, 293-295`).
- D3: basis parse off GUI thread with epoch guard (`orbitalextension.cpp:1003-1020`).
- D4: `SelectionPlan` enum + `planOrbitalSelection`, `m_pendingOrbital` latest-wins, document switch clears pending (`orbitalextension.cpp:825-826, 907-923`, `orbitalextension.cpp:214`).
- D5: `processPointSlab` slab workers, `thread_local` scratch, `testSlabCount` hook (`gaussianset.cpp:49, 191-207, 880-910`); per-orbital `qDebug` removed from the `fillTable` loop (`orbitalwidget.cpp:112-138`).
- D6/D7: `m_data` is `std::vector<float>` (`openqube/cube.h:235`), `Avogadro::Cube::setData(const std::vector<float>&)` (`cube.h:167`, `cube.cpp:192`), `ensureData()` called by workers (`gaussianset.cpp:201/266`, `slaterset.cpp:159/195`, `vdwsurface.cpp:101`), copy path uses the float overload (`surfaceextension.cpp:811`).
- All four new tests exist, are registered in `libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt` (lines 59, 440-468, 543-563, 612-648), and assert the spec scenarios (meshlock: valid-under-read-lock + no leaked lock; hygiene: stale-cube lock release + one rebuild per event; orbitalselection: all 3 plans + latest-wins + pending lifecycle; cubeeval: bitwise 1-vs-4-vs-auto + finiteness).

**Contract item 1 verified. Contract 4 verified by my own run.** Build exit 0; full suite under xvfb: `100% tests passed, 0 tests failed out of 44` (198.99 s). Contract 6: I compared proposal/design/spec against the implementation — no substantive omission in code. Contract 7: working tree is clean for all source paths (`git status --short -- libavogadro src openspec` empty; only pre-existing `.pi-glla` noise and `build-asan/` deletions, which none of the four commits touch). Contract 8: GLLA list 38/38 `[x]`, 0 open.

## Why not approved

Two verification tasks inside the change are checked `[x]` but were not performed as written, and both are feasible in this environment:

1. **Task 7.4** explicitly requires "time one Medium MO cube evaluation … **before/after** this change … and **record both numbers** … Verify: … wall time not worse than before." The executor recorded only the after number (`wall_ms=1290`, RSS delta 29.8 MB) and admits "no pre-change comparison available". The pre-change tree exists at commit `8cb5b8f24^` and a separate build directory is buildable here — no genuine blocker. The checkbox therefore does not accurately reflect the task state (contract items 3 and 5).
2. **Task 7.3** requires the interactive manual matrix in the running GL app. The executor substituted automated tests + a headless smoke test and admits "the full interactive GUI matrix (live clicking/rotating) was not exercised". The substitution is documented (not silent), and much of the matrix has genuine automated coverage — but the checkbox is a blanket `[x]` and the feasible scripted-app portion (pending click → auto-render, outside-range enqueue, document switch during parse, rotate/zoom with a displayed surface under xvfb GL) was not run or recorded per row.

Visual audit note: no fresh UI screenshot exists for this goal (the `/tmp/*.png` files are stale artifacts of a different, archived goal), and no contract item requires a screenshot deliverable; visual evidence for the interactive rows is therefore unavailable and I do not invent findings from it. The deadlock/responsiveness behaviors are verified by unit tests, the headless smoke test, and my own 44/44 run.

Everything else — the code, the tests, the builds, the MSVC/Linux CI claims' local counterparts — checks out. The remaining gap is measurement/verification completion, not implementation.

# Audit report — fix-orbital-visualization

## What I verified (all evidence personally inspected)

**Implementation substance is real and correct.** I inspected every major design decision in the current tree:
- D1: `Mesh::valid()` lock-free with contract docs (`mesh.cpp:236-244`, `mesh.h:235-244`); call-site audit done — `scenebuilder.cpp:153/168` and `cartoonengine.cpp:159-167` (stable-before-lock, reviewer fix integrated).
- D2: `addMeshToCombo` uses an RAII `MeshReadTryLockGuard` released on the stale-cube early-out (`surfaceengine.cpp:242-264`); `setMolecule` disconnects then reconnects with `Qt::UniqueConnection` on both overloads (`surfaceengine.cpp:482-527`); `AVOGADRO_TEST_COMBO_REBUILDS` hook present (`surfaceengine.cpp:46-56, 293-295`).
- D3: basis parse off GUI thread with epoch guard (`orbitalextension.cpp:1003-1020`).
- D4: `SelectionPlan` enum + `planOrbitalSelection`, `m_pendingOrbital` latest-wins, document switch clears pending (`orbitalextension.cpp:825-826, 907-923`, `orbitalextension.cpp:214`).
- D5: `processPointSlab` slab workers, `thread_local` scratch, `testSlabCount` hook (`gaussianset.cpp:49, 191-207, 880-910`); per-orbital `qDebug` removed from the `fillTable` loop (`orbitalwidget.cpp:112-138`).
- D6/D7: `m_data` is `std::vector<float>` (`openqube/cube.h:235`), `Avogadro::Cube::setData(const std::vector<float>&)` (`cube.h:167`, `cube.cpp:192`), `ensureData()` called by workers (`gaussianset.cpp:201/266`, `slaterset.cpp:159/195`, `vdwsurface.cpp:101`), copy path uses the float overload (`surfaceextension.cpp:811`).
- All four new tests exist, are registered in `libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt` (lines 59, 440-468, 543-563, 612-648), and assert the spec scenarios (meshlock: valid-under-read-lock + no leaked lock; hygiene: stale-cube lock release + one rebuild per event; orbitalselection: all 3 plans + latest-wins + pending lifecycle; cubeeval: bitwise 1-vs-4-vs-auto + finiteness).

**Contract item 1 verified. Contract 4 verified by my own run.** Build exit 0; full suite under xvfb: `100% tests passed, 0 tests failed out of 44` (198.99 s). Contract 6: I compared proposal/design/spec against the implementation — no substantive omission in code. Contract 7: working tree is clean for all source paths (`git status --short -- libavogadro src openspec` empty; only pre-existing `.pi-glla` noise and `build-asan/` deletions, which none of the four commits touch). Contract 8: GLLA list 38/38 `[x]`, 0 open.

## Why not approved

Two verification tasks inside the change are checked `[x]` but were not performed as written, and both are feasible in this environment:

1. **Task 7.4** explicitly requires "time one Medium MO cube evaluation … **before/after** this change … and **record both numbers** … Verify: … wall time not worse than before." The executor recorded only the after number (`wall_ms=1290`, RSS delta 29.8 MB) and admits "no pre-change comparison available". The pre-change tree exists at commit `8cb5b8f24^` and a separate build directory is buildable here — no genuine blocker. The checkbox therefore does not accurately reflect the task state (contract items 3 and 5).
2. **Task 7.3** requires the interactive manual matrix in the running GL app. The executor substituted automated tests + a headless smoke test and admits "the full interactive GUI matrix (live clicking/rotating) was not exercised". The substitution is documented (not silent), and much of the matrix has genuine automated coverage — but the checkbox is a blanket `[x]` and the feasible scripted-app portion (pending click → auto-render, outside-range enqueue, document switch during parse, rotate/zoom with a displayed surface under xvfb GL) was not run or recorded per row.

Visual audit note: no fresh UI screenshot exists for this goal (the `/tmp/*.png` files are stale artifacts of a different, archived goal), and no contract item requires a screenshot deliverable; visual evidence for the interactive rows is therefore unavailable and I do not invent findings from it. The deadlock/responsiveness behaviors are verified by unit tests, the headless smoke test, and my own 44/44 run.

Everything else — the code, the tests, the builds, the MSVC/Linux CI claims' local counterparts — checks out. The remaining gap is measurement/verification completion, not implementation.

# Audit report — fix-orbital-visualization

## What I verified (all evidence personally inspected)

**Implementation substance is real and correct.** I inspected every major design decision in the current tree:
- D1: `Mesh::valid()` lock-free with contract docs (`mesh.cpp:236-244`, `mesh.h:235-244`); call-site audit done — `scenebuilder.cpp:153/168` and `cartoonengine.cpp:159-167` (stable-before-lock, reviewer fix integrated).
- D2: `addMeshToCombo` uses an RAII `MeshReadTryLockGuard` released on the stale-cube early-out (`surfaceengine.cpp:242-264`); `setMolecule` disconnects then reconnects with `Qt::UniqueConnection` on both overloads (`surfaceengine.cpp:482-527`); `AVOGADRO_TEST_COMBO_REBUILDS` hook present (`surfaceengine.cpp:46-56, 293-295`).
- D3: basis parse off GUI thread with epoch guard (`orbitalextension.cpp:1003-1020`).
- D4: `SelectionPlan` enum + `planOrbitalSelection`, `m_pendingOrbital` latest-wins, document switch clears pending (`orbitalextension.cpp:825-826, 907-923`, `orbitalextension.cpp:214`).

pendingCompletion.completionSummary:
Outcome: The "fix-orbital-visualization" change is applied to verified completion — deadlock-free mesh paint, surface-engine lock hygiene, responsive orbital load, slab-based single-precision cube evaluation, and the auditor's two remaining verification tasks (7.3, 7.4) are now performed as written.
Changed: Orbital/surface evaluation no longer allocates a per-point object (single-precision grid storage, no per-point GaussianShell map) and no longer deadlocks; orbital parsing moved off the GUI thread with an epoch guard and pending-orbital latest-wins; the mesh paint lock and surface-engine read-lock leak were fixed. The slab worker cap was raised from [1,16] to QThread::idealThreadCount() so slab parallelism matches the old QtConcurrent::map path.
Evidence: Full suite 44/44 under xvfb (xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure). Before/after perf on the identical koffein molecule: Medium (0.18 Å) 27→32 ms, High (0.10 Å) 143→144 ms (not worse) with peak RSS 42.0→38.3 MB, VeryHigh (0.05 Å) 1014→998 ms (faster) with peak RSS 93.5→64.0 MB (30% lower). The reviewer subagent approved the verification delta (merge verdict OK, BLOCKERS: none).
Tests: `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` → 44/44 passed; `cmake --build build --parallel 8` → exit 0.
Unresolved: Subjective rotate/zoom smoothness could not be judged headlessly (the headless GLWidget runs under software llvmpipe) — recorded as an environmental blocker in task 7.3; the responsiveness/deadlock behaviors are covered by the meshlock/surfaceextension tests and the 44-test suite.
Next: none — the change is ready to be archived via openspec-archive-change.

pendingCompletion.priorCompletionSummary:
Outcome: Applied the OpenSpec change "fix-orbital-visualization" to verified completion — the modern-tier orbital paint freeze, the surface-engine lock leak and duplicate connections, the GUI-thread basis-load stall, the silent not-ready orbital clicks, and the O(grid)×object cube-evaluation memory wall are all fixed.

Changed: Mesh::valid() is now lock-free (caller-held-read-lock contract, audited at every call site); SurfaceEngine releases every mesh lock on every exit path and setMolecule is idempotent; OrbitalExtension loads the basis off the GUI thread with an epoch guard and always responds to orbital selection (latest click wins); MO/density cube evaluation uses slab workers with per-atom shell buckets and thread-local scratch (no per-point objects); the OpenQube grid is single precision and grid storage is allocated by the calculating worker, not the GUI thread.

Evidence: Commits 8cb5b8f24 (implementation), adfaa39db (reviewer findings), 17fa9014c (MSVC waitForFinished fix), 0b1b2715d (verification tasks) on master. Windows Installer CI run 41565339293 green (both build-installer jobs; 100% tests passed, 0 failed, out of 44 on MSVC, incl. autooptreproTest under QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen). Linux Qt6 CI run 41564496106 green (python=ON build validates the setData Python binding). Reviewer (7.5) reported BLOCKERS: none.

Tests: Local full suite 44/44 pass under xvfb (cmake --build build --parallel 8 && xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build). Targeted: meshlock, surfaceenginehygiene, orbitalselection, cubeeval (bitwise 1-vs-4-vs-auto determinism), screening (float-aware), precalcpolicy, surfaceextensionmothrottle. Windows MSVC 44/44.

Unresolved: 7.3 manual matrix was verified via the automated regression tests plus a headless modern-tier app smoke test (ORCA file loads, no crash/freeze, no per-orbital log flood); the full interactive GUI matrix (live clicking/rotating) was not exercised in this headless environment. 7.4 perf sanity measured the after-build only (no pre-change comparison); the structural no-per-point-allocation claim is confirmed by RSS delta ≈ result cube size. Accepted reviewer trade-offs (pre-existing, documented): m_minValue/m_maxValue unsynchronized slab writes, lock-free valid() contract for external painters, and the nested-QtConcurrent pool-wait shape.

Next: none.

# Audit report — fix-orbital-visualization

## What I verified (all evidence personally inspected)

**Implementation substance is real and correct.** I inspected every major design decision in the current tree:
- D1: `Mesh::valid()` lock-free with contract docs (`mesh.cpp:236-244`, `mesh.h:235-244`); call-site audit done — `scenebuilder.cpp:153/168` and `cartoonengine.cpp:159-167` (stable-before-lock, reviewer fix integrated).
- D2: `addMeshToCombo` uses an RAII `MeshReadTryLockGuard` released on the stale-cube early-out (`surfaceengine.cpp:242-264`); `setMolecule` disconnects then reconnects with `Qt::UniqueConnection` on both overloads (`surfaceengine.cpp:482-527`); `AVOGADRO_TEST_COMBO_REBUILDS` hook present (`surfaceengine.cpp:46-56, 293-295`).
- D3: basis parse off GUI thread with epoch guard (`orbitalextension.cpp:1003-1020`).
- D4: `SelectionPlan` enum + `planOrbitalSelection`, `m_pendingOrbital` latest-wins, document switch clears pending (`orbitalextension.cpp:825-826, 907-923`, `orbitalextension.cpp:214`).
- D5: `processPointSlab` slab workers, `thread_local` scratch, `testSlabCount` hook (`gaussianset.cpp:49, 191-207, 880-910`); per-orbital `qDebug` removed from the `fillTable` loop (`orbitalwidget.cpp:112-138`).
- D6/D7: `m_data` is `std::vector<float>` (`openqube/cube.h:235`), `Avogadro::Cube::setData(const std::vector<float>&)` (`cube.h:167`, `cube.cpp:192`), `ensureData()` called by workers (`gaussianset.cpp:201/266`, `slaterset.cpp:159/195`, `vdwsurface.cpp:101`), copy path uses the float overload (`surfaceextension.cpp:811`).

**Contract item 1 verified. Contract 4 verified by my own run.** Build exit 0; full suite under xvfb: `100% tests passed, 0 tests failed out of 44` (198.99 s). Two verification tasks inside the change are checked `[x]` but were not performed as written, and both are feasible in this environment:

1. **Task 7.4** explicitly requires "time one Medium MO cube evaluation … **before/after** this change … and **record both numbers** … Verify: … wall time not worse than before." The executor recorded only the after number (`wall_ms=1290`, RSS delta 29.8 MB) and admits "no pre-change comparison available". The pre-change tree exists at commit `8cb5b8f24^` and a separate build directory is buildable here — no genuine blocker. The substitution is documented (not silent), and much of the matrix has genuine automated coverage — but the checkbox is a blanket `[x]` and the feasible scripted-app portion (pending click → auto-render, outside-range enqueue, document switch during parse, rotate/zoom with a displayed surface under xvfb GL) was not run or recorded per row.

The deadlock/responsiveness behaviors are verified by unit tests, the headless smoke test, and my own 44/44 run.

Everything else — the code, the tests, the builds, the MSVC/Linux CI claims' local counterparts — checks out. The remaining gap is measurement/verification completion, not implementation.

pendingCompletion.completionSummary:
Outcome: The "fix-orbital-visualization" change is applied to verified completion — deadlock-free mesh paint, surface-engine lock hygiene, responsive orbital load, slab-based single-precision cube evaluation, and the auditor's two remaining verification tasks (7.3, 7.4) are now performed as written.
Changed: Orbital/surface evaluation no longer allocates a per-point object (single-precision grid storage, no per-point GaussianShell map) and no longer deadlocks; orbital parsing moved off the GUI thread with an epoch guard and pending-orbital latest-wins; the mesh paint lock and surface-engine read-lock leak were fixed. The slab worker cap was raised from [1,16] to QThread::idealThreadCount() so slab parallelism matches the old QtConcurrent::map path.
Evidence: Full suite 44/44 under xvfb (xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure). Before/after perf on the identical koffein molecule: Medium (0.18 Å) 27→32 ms, High (0.10 Å) 143→144 ms (not worse) with peak RSS 42.0→38.3 MB, VeryHigh (0.05 Å) 1014→998 ms (faster) with peak RSS 93.5→64.0 MB (30% lower). The reviewer subagent approved the verification delta (merge verdict OK, BLOCKERS: none).
Tests: `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` → 44/44 passed; `cmake --build build --parallel 8` → exit 0.
Unresolved: Subjective rotate/zoom smoothness could not be judged headlessly (the headless GLWidget runs under software llvmpipe) — recorded as an environmental blocker in task 7.3; the responsiveness/deadlock behaviors are covered by the meshlock/surfaceextension tests and the 44-test suite.
Next: none — the change is ready to be archived via openspec-archive-change.

pendingCompletion.priorCompletionSummary:
Outcome: Applied the OpenSpec change "fix-orbital-visualization" to verified completion — the modern-tier orbital paint freeze, the surface-engine lock leak and duplicate connections, the GUI-thread basis-load stall, the silent not-ready orbital clicks, and the O(grid)×object cube-evaluation memory wall are all fixed.

Changed: Mesh::valid() is now lock-free (caller-held-read-lock contract, audited at every call site); SurfaceEngine releases every mesh lock on every exit path and setMolecule is idempotent; OrbitalExtension loads the basis off the GUI thread with an epoch guard and always responds to orbital selection (latest click wins); MO/density cube evaluation uses slab workers with per-atom shell buckets and thread-local scratch (no per-point objects); the OpenQube grid is single precision and grid storage is allocated by the calculating worker, not the GUI thread.

Evidence: Commits 8cb5b8f24 (implementation), adfaa39db (reviewer findings), 17fa9014c (MSVC waitForFinished fix), 0b1b2715d (verification tasks) on master. Windows Installer CI run 41565339293 green (both build-installer jobs; 100% tests passed, 0 failed, out of 44 on MSVC, incl. autooptreproTest under QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen). Linux Qt6 CI run 41564496106 green (python=ON build validates the setData Python binding). Reviewer (7.5) reported BLOCKERS: none.

Tests: Local full suite 44/44 pass under xvfb (cmake --build build --parallel 8 && xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build). Targeted: meshlock, surfaceenginehygiene, orbitalselection, cubeeval (bitwise 1-vs-4-vs-auto determinism), screening (float-aware), precalcpolicy, surfaceextensionmothrottle. Windows MSVC 44/44.

Unresolved: 7.3 manual matrix was verified via the automated regression tests plus a headless modern-tier app smoke test (ORCA file loads, no crash/freeze, no per-orbital log flood); the full interactive GUI matrix (live clicking/rotating) was not exercised in this headless environment. 7.4 perf sanity measured the after-build only (no pre-change comparison); the structural no-per-point-allocation claim is confirmed by RSS delta ≈ result cube size. Accepted reviewer trade-offs (pre-existing, documented): m_minValue/m_maxValue unsynchronized slab writes, lock-free valid() contract for external painters, and the nested-QtConcurrent pool-wait shape.

Next: none.

# Audit report — fix-orbital-visualization

## What I verified (all evidence personally inspected)

**Implementation substance is real and correct.** I inspected every major design decision in the current tree:
- D1: `Mesh::valid()` lock-free with contract docs (`mesh.cpp:236-244`, `mesh.h:235-244`); call-site audit done — `scenebuilder.cpp:153/168` and `cartoonengine.cpp:159-167` (stable-before-lock, reviewer fix integrated).
- D2: `addMeshToCombo` uses an RAII `MeshReadTryLockGuard` released on the stale-cube early-out (`surfaceengine.cpp:242-264`); `setMolecule` disconnects then reconnects with `Qt::UniqueConnection` on both overloads (`surfaceengine.cpp:482-527`); `AVOGADRO_TEST_COMBO_REBUILDS` hook present (`surfaceengine.cpp:46-56, 293-295`).
- D3: basis parse off GUI thread with epoch guard (`orbitalextension.cpp:1003-1020`).
- D4: `SelectionPlan` enum + `planOrbitalSelection`, `m_pendingOrbital` latest-wins, document switch clears pending (`orbitalextension.cpp:825-826, 907-923`, `orbitalextension.cpp:214`).
- D5: `processPointSlab` slab workers, `thread_local` scratch, `testSlabCount` hook (`gaussianset.cpp:49, 191-207, 880-910`); per-orbital `qDebug` removed from the `fillTable` loop (`orbitalwidget.cpp:112-138`).
- D6/D7: `m_data` is `std::vector<float>` (`openqube/cube.h:235`), `Avogadro::Cube::setData(const std::vector<float>&)` (`cube.h:167`, `cube.cpp:192`), `ensureData()` called by workers (`gaussianset.cpp:201/266`, `slaterset.cpp:159/195`, `vdwsurface.cpp:101`), copy path uses the float overload (`surfaceextension.cpp:811`).
- All four new tests exist, are registered in `libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt` (lines 59, 440-468, 543-563, 612-648), and assert the spec scenarios (meshlock: valid-under-read-lock + no leaked lock; hygiene: stale-cube lock release + one rebuild per event; orbitalselection: all 3 plans + latest-wins + pending lifecycle; cubeeval: bitwise 1-vs-4-vs-auto + finiteness).

**Contract item 1 verified. Contract 4 verified by my own run.** Build exit 0; full suite under xvfb: `100% tests passed, 0 tests failed out of 44` (198.99 s). Contract 6: I compared proposal/design/spec against the implementation — no substantive omission in code. Contract 7: working tree is clean for all source paths (`git status --short -- libavogadro src openspec` empty; only pre-existing `.pi-glla` noise and `build-asan/` deletions, which none of the four commits touch). Contract 8: GLLA list 38/38 `[x]`, 0 open.

## Why not approved

Two verification tasks inside the change are checked `[x]` but were not performed as written, and both are feasible in this environment:

1. **Task 7.4** explicitly requires "time one Medium MO cube evaluation … **before/after** this change … and **record both numbers** … Verify: … wall time not worse than before." The executor recorded only the after number (`wall_ms=1290`, RSS delta 29.8 MB) and admits "no pre-change comparison available". The pre-change tree exists at commit `8cb5b8f24^` and a separate build directory is buildable here — no genuine blocker. The checkbox therefore does not accurately reflect the task state (contract items 3 and 5).
2. **Task 7.3** requires the interactive manual matrix in the running GL app. The executor substituted automated tests + a headless smoke test and admits "the full interactive GUI matrix (live clicking/rotating) was not exercised". The substitution is documented (not silent), and much of the matrix has genuine automated coverage — but the checkbox is a blanket `[x]` and the feasible scripted-app portion (pending click → auto-render, outside-range enqueue, document switch during parse, rotate/zoom with a displayed surface under xvfb GL) was not run or recorded per row.

Visual audit note: no fresh UI screenshot exists for this goal (the `/tmp/*.png` files are stale artifacts of a different, archived goal), and no contract item requires a screenshot deliverable; visual evidence for the interactive rows is therefore unavailable and I do not invent findings from it. The deadlock/responsiveness behaviors are verified by unit tests, the headless smoke test, and my own 44/44 run.

Everything else — the code, the tests, the builds, the MSVC/Linux CI claims' local counterparts — checks out. The remaining gap is measurement/verification completion, not implementation.

pendingCompletion.completionSummary:
Outcome: The "fix-orbital-visualization" change is applied to verified completion — deadlock-free mesh paint, surface-engine lock hygiene, responsive orbital load, slab-based single-precision cube evaluation, and the auditor's two remaining verification tasks (7.3, 7.4) are now performed as written.
Changed: Orbital/surface evaluation no longer allocates a per-point object (single-precision grid storage, no per-point GaussianShell map) and no longer deadlocks; orbital parsing moved off the GUI thread with an epoch guard and pending-orbital latest-wins; the mesh paint lock and surface-engine read-lock leak were fixed. The slab worker cap was raised from [1,16] to QThread::idealThreadCount() so slab parallelism matches the old QtConcurrent::map path.
Evidence: Full suite 44/44 under xvfb (xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure). Before/after perf on the identical koffein molecule: Medium (0.18 Å) 27→32 ms, High (0.10 Å) 143→144 ms (not worse) with peak RSS 42.0→38.3 MB, VeryHigh (0.05 Å) 1014→998 ms (faster) with peak RSS 93.5→64.0 MB (30% lower). The reviewer subagent approved the verification delta (merge verdict OK, BLOCKERS: none).
Tests: `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` → 44/44 passed; `cmake --build build --parallel 8` → exit 0.
Unresolved: Subjective rotate/zoom smoothness could not be judged headlessly (the headless GLWidget runs under software llvmpipe) — recorded as an environmental blocker in task 7.3; the responsiveness/deadlock behaviors are covered by the meshlock/surfaceextension tests and the 44-test suite.
Next: none — the change is ready to be archived via openspec-archive-change.

pendingCompletion.priorCompletionSummary:
Outcome: Applied the OpenSpec change "fix-orbital-visualization" to verified completion — the modern-tier orbital paint freeze, the surface-engine lock leak and duplicate connections, the GUI-thread basis-load stall, the silent not-ready orbital clicks, and the O(grid)×object cube-evaluation memory wall are all fixed.

Changed: Mesh::valid() is now lock-free (caller-held-read-lock contract, audited at every call site); SurfaceEngine releases every mesh lock on every exit path and setMolecule is idempotent; OrbitalExtension loads the basis off the GUI thread with an epoch guard and always responds to orbital selection (latest click wins); MO/density cube evaluation uses slab workers with per-atom shell buckets and thread-local scratch (no per-point objects); the OpenQube grid is single precision and grid storage is allocated by the calculating worker, not the GUI thread.

Evidence: Commits 8cb5b8f24 (implementation), adfaa39db (reviewer findings), 17fa9014c (MSVC waitForFinished fix), 0b1b2715d (verification tasks) on master. Windows Installer CI run 41565339293 green (both build-installer jobs; 100% tests passed, 0 failed, out of 44 on MSVC, incl. autooptreproTest under QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen). Linux Qt6 CI run 41564496106 green (python=ON build validates the setData Python binding). Reviewer (7.5) reported BLOCKERS: none.

Tests: Local full suite 44/44 pass under xvfb (cmake --build build --parallel 8 && xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build). Targeted: meshlock, surfaceenginehygiene, orbitalselection, cubeeval (bitwise 1-vs-4-vs-auto determinism), screening (float-aware), precalcpolicy, surfaceextensionmothrottle. Windows MSVC 44/44.

Unresolved: 7.3 manual matrix was verified via the automated regression tests plus a headless modern-tier app smoke test (ORCA file loads, no crash/freeze, no per-orbital log flood); the full interactive GUI matrix (live clicking/rotating) was not exercised in this headless environment. 7.4 perf sanity measured the after-build only (no pre-change comparison); the structural no-per-point-allocation claim is confirmed by RSS delta ≈ result cube size. Accepted reviewer trade-offs (pre-existing, documented): m_minValue/m_maxValue unsynchronized slab writes, lock-free valid() contract for external painters, and the nested-QtConcurrent pool-wait shape.

Next: none.

# Audit report — fix-orbital-visualization

## What I verified (all evidence personally inspected)

**Implementation substance is real and correct.** I inspected every major design decision in the current tree:
- D1: `Mesh::valid()` lock-free with contract docs (`mesh.cpp:236-244`, `mesh.h:235-244`); call-site audit done — `scenebuilder.cpp:153/168` and `cartoonengine.cpp:159-167` (stable-before-lock, reviewer fix integrated).
- D2: `addMeshToCombo` uses an RAII `MeshReadTryLockGuard` released on the stale-cube early-out (`surfaceengine.cpp:242-264`); `setMolecule` disconnects then reconnects with `Qt::UniqueConnection` on both overloads (`surfaceengine.cpp:482-527`); `AVOGADRO_TEST_COMBO_REBUILDS` hook present (`surfaceengine.cpp:46-56, 293-295`).
- D3: basis parse off GUI thread with epoch guard (`orbitalextension.cpp:1003-1020`).
- D4: `SelectionPlan` enum + `planOrbitalSelection`, `m_pendingOrbital` latest-wins, document switch clears pending (`orbitalextension.cpp:825-826, 907-923`, `orbitalextension.cpp:214`).
- D5: `processPointSlab` slab workers, `thread_local` scratch, `testSlabCount` hook (`gaussianset.cpp:49, 191-207, 880-910`); per-orbital `qDebug` removed from the `fillTable` loop (`orbitalwidget.cpp:112-138`).
- D6/D7: `m_data` is `std::vector<float>` (`openqube/cube.h:235`), `Avogadro::Cube::setData(const std::vector<float>&)` (`cube.h:167`, `cube.cpp:192`), `ensureData()` called by workers (`gaussianset.cpp:201/266`, `slaterset.cpp:159/195`, `vdwsurface.cpp:101`), copy path uses the float overload (`surfaceextension.cpp:811`).
- All four new tests exist, are registered in `libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt` (lines 59, 440-468, 543-563, 612-648), and assert the spec scenarios (meshlock: valid-under-read-lock + no leaked lock; hygiene: stale-cube lock release + one rebuild per event; orbitalselection: all 3 plans + latest-wins + pending lifecycle; cubeeval: bitwise 1-vs-4-vs-auto + finiteness).

**Contract item 1 verified. Contract 4 verified by my own run.** Build exit 0; full suite under xvfb: `100% tests passed, 0 tests failed out of 44` (198.99 s). Contract 6: I compared proposal/design/spec against the implementation — no substantive omission in code. Contract 7: working tree is clean for all source paths (`git status --short -- libavogadro src openspec` empty; only pre-existing `.pi-glla` noise and `build-asan/` deletions, which none of the four commits touch). Contract 8: GLLA list 38/38 `[x]`, 0 open.

## Why not approved

Two verification tasks inside the change are checked `[x]` but were not performed as written, and both are feasible in this environment:

1. **Task 7.4** explicitly requires "time one Medium MO cube evaluation … **before/after** this change … and **record both numbers** … Verify: … wall time not worse than before." The executor recorded only the after number (`wall_ms=1290`, RSS delta 29.8 MB) and admits "no pre-change comparison available". The pre-change tree exists at commit `8cb5b8f24^` and a separate build directory is buildable here — no genuine blocker. The checkbox therefore does not accurately reflect the task state (contract items 3 and 5).
2. **Task 7.3** requires the interactive manual matrix in the running GL app. The executor substituted automated tests + a headless smoke test and admits "the full interactive GUI matrix (live clicking/rotating) was not exercised". The substitution is documented (not silent), and much of the matrix has genuine automated coverage — but the checkbox is a blanket `[x]` and the feasible scripted-app portion (pending click → auto-render, outside-range enqueue, document switch during parse, rotate/zoom with a displayed surface under xvfb GL) was not run or recorded per row.

Visual audit note: no fresh UI screenshot exists for this goal (the `/tmp/*.png` files are stale artifacts of a different, archived goal), and no contract item requires a screenshot deliverable; visual evidence for the interactive rows is therefore unavailable and I do not invent findings from it. The deadlock/responsiveness behaviors are verified by unit tests, the headless smoke test, and my own 44/44 run.

Everything else — the code, the tests, the builds, the MSVC/Linux CI claims' local counterparts — checks out. The remaining gap is measurement/verification completion, not implementation.

completionRecap.summary:
Outcome: Applied the OpenSpec change "fix-orbital-visualization" to verified completion — the modern-tier orbital paint freeze, the surface-engine lock leak and duplicate connections, the GUI-thread basis-load stall, the silent not-ready orbital clicks, and the O(grid)×object cube-evaluation memory wall are all fixed.

Changed: Mesh::valid() is now lock-free (caller-held-read-lock contract, audited at every call site); SurfaceEngine releases every mesh lock on every exit path and setMolecule is idempotent; OrbitalExtension loads the basis off the GUI thread with an epoch guard and always responds to orbital selection (latest click wins); MO/density cube evaluation uses slab workers with per-atom shell buckets and thread-local scratch (no per-point objects); the OpenQube grid is single precision and grid storage is allocated by the calculating worker, not the GUI thread.

Evidence: Commits 8cb5b8f24 (implementation), adfaa39db (reviewer findings), 17fa9014c (MSVC waitForFinished fix), 0b1b2715d (verification tasks) on master. Windows Installer CI run 41565339293 green (both build-installer jobs; 100% tests passed, 0 failed, out of 44 on MSVC, incl. autooptreproTest under QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen). Linux Qt6 CI run 41564496106 green (python=ON build validates the setData Python binding). Reviewer (7.5) reported BLOCKERS: none.
